categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Kick category names or slugs, e.g. Slots, Poker, Just Chatting, Grand Theft Auto V, Counter-Strike 2. Returns streamers live in each right now, biggest first.

searchQueries.title: Search queries (optional)
searchQueries.description: Free-text channel search, e.g. casino, crypto, fitness. Also finds offline channels (up to 20 per query).

channels.title: Specific channels (optional)
channels.description: Kick channel names or URLs to look up directly, e.g. xqc or https://kick.com/xqc.

languages.title: Stream languages (optional)
languages.description: Keep only live streamers broadcasting in these languages, e.g. English, Spanish, Portuguese. Applies to category results.

minFollowers.title: Min followers (optional)
minFollowers.description: Only streamers with at least this many followers.

maxFollowers.title: Max followers (optional)
maxFollowers.description: Only streamers with at most this many followers. Set 1000-50000 to target smaller creators.

requireEmail.title: Only streamers with a business email
requireEmail.description: Skip streamers whose bio contains no email address.

maxStreamers.title: Max streamers per run
maxStreamers.description: Cap on streamer rows returned. Controls total cost.

dedupe.title: Skip streamers seen in previous runs
dedupe.description: Remember returned streamers across runs and skip them. Turn on for scheduled prospecting.
